source.name: Federal Reserve Board H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates
source.series: H.10 daily Japanese yen per U.S. dollar
source.license: Public domain (U.S. Federal Reserve Board), citation requested
source.observation: 252 × mean of five squared log changes between consecutive published USD/JPY fixes
notes: The source reports noon buying rates in New York, in Japanese yen per U.S. dollar.
ND observations are skipped. No holidays or missing observations are filled.
Each forecast step advances one published fix. Adjacent proxies share four squared log changes.
The series measures variation between reference fixes and omits within-day price movements.
The source can revise historical values. Compare observationsSha256 to verify the snapshot.

settings.target: Terminal variance proxy measured at the target observation
